product_one_liner.value: Alice provides AI safety and security testing, runtime guardrails, and ongoing monitoring for foundation-model labs, enterprises deploying AI applications and agents, and user-generated-content platforms.

pricing_page.notes: No public pricing plans were found in the site navigation; the commercial call to action is a demo/contact form, and /pricing returned no page.

employee_band.notes: The August 2026 funding coverage reports approximately 400 employees.

hq_location.notes: The company identifies dual headquarters: New York, United States, and Tel Aviv, Israel.

eng_blog.notes: Engineering @ Alice publishes Noam Levy’s implementation posts on ActiveScore scaling and NeMo Guardrails integration.

public_docs.notes: Public documentation includes product user guides, API documentation and SDK documentation.

ai_ml_roles_open.notes: The live Principal Data Scientist posting qualifies.

model_provider.value: Google ShieldGemma (based on Gemma 2), used as the teacher model to distill Alice’s production WonderFence safety detectors.

compliance_certs.notes: These are publicly claimed badges/certifications; the HIPAA badge says HIPAA compliant. This is not independent attestation verification.

last_funding.notes: Announced August 25, 2026; led by Apax Digital.

raised_18mo.notes: The August 25, 2026 financing falls within May 9, 2025–November 9, 2026.

hiring_sdr_ae.notes: Live Sales Development Representative and GenAI Account Executive postings.

launched_6mo.notes: May 13, 2026: introduced policy-specific WonderFence guardrails trained on customer policies and real-world adversarial examples, within May 9–November 9, 2026.

leadership_change_12mo.notes: On April 6, 2026, Yossi Mizrahi announced joining Alice as VP GenAI.

crm_stack_signal.notes: The privacy policy names these systems for CRM, mailing-list management, and website analytics. The SDR posting additionally lists HubSpot, Outreach and Salesloft as example tools for candidate experience, not definitive proof of deployment.
